text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a concrete handshake between runtime/infra and console for the new latency/throughput panels (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec). I'll sketch constraints, want feedback before I open the PR.
kevin: +1. what are the ownership boundaries you're thinking?
satoshi: Runtime will emit raw samples and aggregation helpers. But we need a stable metric schema first.
tina: Console needs stable series names + tags. Otherwise dashboards break every release.
maria: Proposed: runtime emits per-request timing histograms (ttft_ms histogram), token_rate gauge, and per-step counters. Add these tags: route_id, model_id, variant, region, deployment_tier, batch_size_bucket, seq_len_bucket, tenant_hash.
ryan: tenant_hash good for privacy. How will quota-owned metrics (tokens/sec vs quota windows) map?
kevin: Quotas live in infra; they can export quota_usage_{tenant,route} as a derived gauge. But we should avoid coupling quota counters with raw runtime histograms.
satoshi: Agree. Runtime: only emit what it knows (latency histograms, tokens_emitted counter, tokens_in_request). Infra/quotas can join on route_id + tenant_hash.
jen: For dashboards we need these computed series: p50/p95/p99 from ttft_ms histogram, ttft_count, tokens_per_sec (windowed), and peak_concurrent. Can runtime provide histogram bucket boundaries versioned?
maria: Yes — include metric_schema_version tag. When schema bumps we keep old and new metrics for 30 days to allow console to migrate.
tina: We'll surface schema_version in the console settings and warn when panels use deprecated schemas. UX: small migration wizard that rebinds panels to new names.
kevin: Sampling: high-traffic routes should sample at 0.1% by default and send a sampled boolean tag so infra can inflate aggregates. Otherwise cardinality explodes.
satoshi: Runtime will include sample_rate tag and a sampling_seed for reproducibility. Also include an example PromQL mapping in the handshake so console can compute rates correctly.
jen: Can you paste the example?
satoshi: Sure:
```
# compute p95 from histogram (Prometheus-style)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_ms_bucket{route_id="R123",schema_v="1"}[5m])) by (le))
# tokens/sec windowed per route
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total{route_id="R123",sampled!="false"}[1m])) by (route_id) / sum(rate(sample_rate{route_id="R123"}[1m])) by (route_id)
```
maria: Note the denominator — we need runtime to export sample_rate as a gauge per route so derived rates are correct.
ryan: For rollouts UX: panels must support showing split traffic (canary vs prod). That means a traffic_split tag on metrics. Console should allow a toggle to show per-split metrics and an aggregated view with weights.
tina: We'll add a 'traffic_split' dropdown in the panel UI. But we need runtime/ingest to ensure traffic_split is present and stable (e.g., values like canary-10 prod-90).
kepon: (was typing)
kevin: Also include batch_size_bucket to surface batching effects on latency/tokens. Without it the p95 will hide huge tail from big batches.
satoshi: We'll also emit a kvcache_hit boolean so console can split hot vs cold requests.
jen: Alerting: suggest default alerts on p99 > 2s for customer-tier, and tokens/sec drop > 50% vs 10m baseline for model-serving routes. Who owns alert thresholds?
ryan: Product sets defaults, infra picks thresholds for infra-tier routes. But panels should expose editable alert templates.
maria: Action items: 1) runtime: PR with metric names, tags, schema_version, sampling fields, histogram buckets (satoshi). 2) infra: add sample_rate per route + quota_exporter mapping (kevin). 3) console: panel templates that consume schema_v=1 and fallback logic (tina/jen). 4) PM: define default alerts and rollout UX language (ryan).
satoshi: I'll drop a draft metrics.md with examples and the exportable PromQLs by EOD.
kevin: I'll stub sample_rate exporter and a test route that emits sampled=true/false.
tina: I'll prototype panel JSON and a migration modal.
jen: I'll coordinate the PRs and add integration test to the dashboard CI that checks schema tags are present.
deploy-bot: deploy started: metrics-schema-v1 -> staging (sha: ab12c3). :rocket:
maria: thanks everyone. one more: can we include an opt-in verbose mode that emits raw request traces for 1% of traffic for SLO debugging? needs privacy guard.
satoshi: yes, add trace_mode=verbose and trace_id redaction flag. We'll gate by tenant opt-in.
ryan: sounds good. i'll file the policy for tenant opt-in.
maria: perfect. i'll open the 'metrics-handshake' issue with the action items and link PRs. ping here when the draft metrics.md is up. :white_check_mark:
